Capital Chronicle's pre-payrolls review gives oil a supply-risk test




Why it matters: The review attributes WTI's move against equities to Hormuz supply risk, without independently confirming that geopolitical premise.




Context: If a ceasefire or agreement is confirmed, the review's supply thesis would no longer hold; de-escalation could reprice the risk premium.




Read the full brief: https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/capital-chronicles-pre-payrolls-review




Capital Chronicle's dated review provides analysis, not independently confirmed event facts or a performance record. Analysis, not financial advice. Readers decide whether to trade.




Capital Chronicle may hold positions in the markets it covers.
